scope_decisions: Table1 bathymetry is seabed context, not current depth or thickness.
PointG/Track142 is retained as monsoon-current outlet context, without asserting strict EICC path membership.
Six Table3 annual-power scales are not the separate60-to150km prose summary or150-to200km recirculation scale. Do not combine them into an annual width range.
Independent source points do not define a continuous current axis or connecting route.
